title: Contracts: access, command states, rows and refused writes for VSB - Application Administrator
preconditions: A test account holding only the role VSB - Application Administrator (one saved session per account); a test project with at least one Development, one Construction and one Project Rights contract, one with payment targets (project asked at run time). A second project outside the account's Dataverse scope, if the role has one.
test_data: Writes only when step 6 needs a refusal: description PW-<runId>-ACC091; deleted afterwards (parity:sweep)
steps:
1. Sign in to the Canvas app (Project Costs) as the role, open the test project, choose Contracts in the left navigation; note the cards, their order and the command bar states with and without a selected contract.
2. Repeat in the Code app: open /costs/contracts?projectId=<test project> through the left navigation and through a deep link, then press F5.
3. Compare the enabled state of Add Development Contract, Add Construction Contract, Add Project Rights Contract, Edit, Delete and, inside an expanded card, Add Period / Edit / Delete.
4. Compare the list of contract cards (type, description) and the payment targets of each card with the Canvas app.
5. Open a project outside the role's business-unit scope (if any) by deep link.
6. Try a write the role is not granted on Dataverse (create, edit or delete a contract) and note the outcome.
expected: The screen is reachable from the left navigation item "Contracts" and by deep link. The Cost app does not read gblCurrentUser role flags on this screen: Add commands follow DataSourceInfo('BoP Projects Contracts', CreatePermission), Edit and Delete follow a selection plus RecordInfo(EditPermission), exactly as in the Canvas app for the same user. The cards and payment targets equal the Canvas rows for this user. A write Dataverse refuses is shown as an error message (banner/toast naming the failed action), never as a silent success or an empty list.
acceptance: Nav item visible AND deep link opens the screen AND each command's enabled state equals Canvas for this user AND the card set (type + description) equals Canvas AND every refused write shows an error text (no silent success).

comments: Needs a real account per role (no mock mode). gblCurrentUser fields read on this screen are only Language and Lang (number/date parsing, Contracts Screen.pa.yaml:2546, 2582, 7402); they gate nothing. Code app: canCreate/canWrite/canDelete come from serverEnforcedProvider (D1, the server refuses and a 403 becomes a message).
